description: This file defines the OrganizationService class in the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to retrieve and save organization general information, acting as a service layer between controllers and data access objects.

classes.name: OrganizationService
classes.description: Service class to manage organization data, including retrieval and persistence of organization information.

methods.name: getOrganizationDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization getter for the OrganizationDao object.

methods.name: setOrganizationDao
methods.description: Setter to inject a custom OrganizationDao instance, supports dependency injection.

methods.name: getOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Retrieves general information about the organization.

methods.name: saveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Saves the provided organization information, may throw a TransactionException.
